questions.question: Identify the relation between Statement I and Statement II. Statement I. The bank's net profit increased significantly in the last quarter. Statement II. The bank implemented cost-cutting measures and improved loan recovery.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the relation between Statement I and Statement II.

Statement I. The bank's net profit increased significantly in the last quarter. Statement II. The bank implemented cost-cutting measures and improved loan recovery.

options.text: I is the cause and II is the effect.
options.html: I is the cause and II is the effect.

options.text: II is the cause and I is the effect.
options.html: II is the cause and I is the effect.

questions.solution:
Statement I. The bank's net profit increased significantly in the last quarter → Effect (The bank's net profit increased significantly.)

Statement II. The bank implemented cost-cutting measures and improved loan recovery → Cause (The bank implemented cost-cutting measures and improved loan recovery)

II is the cause and I is the effect.

questions.question: The following equation is incorrect. Which two signs should be interchanged to correct the equation? 18 + 6 × 4 - 12 ÷ 3 = 17
questions.questionHtml:
The following equation is incorrect. Which two signs should be interchanged to correct the equation?

18 + 6 × 4 - 12 ÷ 3 = 17
questions.solution:
4) Interchanging - and ÷

New equation: 18 + 6 × 4 ÷ 12 - 3

= 18 + 6 × 4 ÷ 12 - 3

= 18 + 24 ÷ 12 - 3

= 18 + 2 - 3

= 20 - 3  = 17

questions.question: The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is TRUE based on the given statements. Statements: J > K = L, M ≥ N < K, O < J < P, N > Q > R Conclusions: I. P > M II. N < P
questions.questionHtml:
The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is TRUE based on the given statements.

Statements:

J > K = L, M ≥ N < K, O < J < P, N > Q > R

Conclusions:

I. P > M

II. N < P

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
options.html: Neither conclusion I nor II is true

options.text: Both conclusion I and II are true
options.html: Both conclusion I and II are true

questions.solution:
From statements:

P > J > K = L

N < K, M ≥ N ⇒ M may be < or > P (undefined)

N < K < J < P ⇒ N < P

Check Conclusions:

I. P > M ⇒ Cannot determine ⇒  FALSE (N < K, M ≥ N ⇒ M may be < or > P (undefined))

II. N < P ⇒ True (N < K < J < P ⇒ N < P)

∴ Only conclusion II is TRUE

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: The government has announced a reduction in LPG subsidies. Conclusions: I. Citizens will now have to pay more for LPG. II. The government has no money left.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The government has announced a reduction in LPG subsidies.

Conclusions:

I. Citizens will now have to pay more for LPG.

II. The government has no money left.
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. Citizens will now have to pay more for LPG → Follow (if subsidies are reduced, the financial support decreases, so people generally have to pay more).

II. The government has no money left → Does not follow (reduction in subsidy does not necessarily mean the government has no money; there could be many other reasons (policy change, budget reallocation, etc)). 

Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: While technological advancements in energy production have made renewable sources more cost-competitive, their intermittent nature means that large-scale adoption will require significant investments in energy storage technologies to stabilize the grid. Assumptions: I. Renewable energy sources are not continuous and need energy storage solutions. II. The high cost of renewable energy production makes its adoption difficult without subsidies. III. Energy storage technologies are a necessary component of a stable energy grid with high renewable energy input.
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: While technological advancements in energy production have made renewable sources more cost-competitive, their intermittent nature means that large-scale adoption will require significant investments in energy storage technologies to stabilize the grid.

Assumptions:

I. Renewable energy sources are not continuous and need energy storage solutions.

II. The high cost of renewable energy production makes its adoption difficult without subsidies.

III. Energy storage technologies are a necessary component of a stable energy grid with high renewable energy input.

options.text: Only I and III are implicit
options.html: Only I and III are implicit

options.text: Only II and III are implicit
options.html: Only II and III are implicit

questions.solution:
⇒ Statement mentions intermittency ⇒ Assumption I is required ✅

⇒ Statement does not mention cost barriers or subsidies ⇒ Assumption II is not required ❌

⇒ Statement says large-scale adoption requires energy storage for grid stability ⇒ Assumption III is required ✅

∴ Assumptions I and III are correct

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Traffic violations have decreased after the installation of speed cameras. Conclusions: I. Surveillance discourages rule-breaking. II. People respect traffic rules voluntarily.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: Traffic violations have decreased after the installation of speed cameras.

Conclusions:

I. Surveillance discourages rule-breaking.

II. People respect traffic rules voluntarily.
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. Surveillance discourages rule-breaking → Follow (because the decrease in violations is linked to the presence of cameras (a form of surveillance), suggesting people are avoiding breaking rules due to monitoring).

II. People respect traffic rules voluntarily → Does not follow ( the statement does not say people are following rules on their own. It suggests behavior changed due to cameras, not voluntary respect)

Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: A 30 L mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3:2. How much milk must be added to make it 4:1?
questions.questionHtml: A 30 L mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3:2. How much milk must be added to make it 4:1?
questions.solution:
Total mixture = 30 L

Milk = 30 × 3/5 = 18 L

Water = 30 × 2/5 = 12 L

Let milk added = x L

New milk = 18 + x, Water = 12

⇒ (18 + x)/12 = 4/1

⇒ 18 + x = 48

⇒ x = 30 L

questions.question: Pointing to a boy, a man said, "He is the son of my wife's sister's husband." How is the boy related to the man?
questions.questionHtml: Pointing to a boy, a man said, "He is the son of my wife's sister's husband." How is the boy related to the man?
questions.solution:
Wife's sister → Sister-in-law

Wife's sister's husband → Brother-in-law of the man

Son of the man's brother-in-law → Nephew

Conclusion:

Clearly, the boy is the Nephew of the man.

Hence, 'Nephew' is the correct answer.
